headline: US Natural Gas Output Reaches New Highs as Domestic and LNG Demand Rise
summary: U.S. natural gas production is on track for a second straight record year. Growth is fueled by power demand from domestic data centers and rising liquefied natural gas exports amid growing global demand for spot cargoes.
why: Natural gas is a primary fuel for electricity generation and heating, with demand increasingly tied to expanding power requirements for artificial intelligence infrastructure and global energy markets.

impacts.name: US Energy Sector
impacts.why: Record production and strong commercial demand for gas-fired power generation support energy producers' revenue.
